nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership/admin checks and as key into balances and allowed mappings
address public owner; set to msg.sender in Ownable constructor, gate for onlyOwner
bool public paused; emergency-stop flag controlling whenNotPaused/whenPaused
mapping(address => uint256) balances; token balance ledger
uint256 totalSupply_; mutable total token supply
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; ERC20 allowances
address public admin; secondary privileged account checked by onlyAdmin
string public welcome; arbitrary string writable by onlyAdmin
uint8 public constant decimals = 18
uint256 public constant TOTAL_SUPPLY = 1000000000 * 10**18
string public constant name = ETHERCToken

decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue) public; subtracts from allowance with branch

ETHERCToken(): sets admin = owner, totalSupply_ = TOTAL_SUPPLY, balances[owner] = TOTAL_SUPPLY
changeAdmin(address _admin) public onlyOwner; reassigns privileged admin
changeWelcome(string _welcome) public onlyAdmin; writes arbitrary state string
burn(uint256 _value) public onlyAdmin; decrements balances[msg.sender] and totalSupply_
batchTransfer(address[] _recipients, uint256[] _values) public onlyAdmin; loops accumulating and distributing values
balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(_value); balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) - arithmetic state mutation in BasicToken.transfer
uint256 total = 0; for(...) total = total.add(_values[i]) - accumulator loop, classic batch-overflow sink
totalSupply_ = totalSupply_.sub(_value) - arithmetic supply mutation in burn
owner = msg.sender - privileged ownership assignment inside Ownable constructor
admin = _admin - privileged admin reassignment inside changeAdmin
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value - allowance overwrite enabling the classic approve race
balances[_recipients[j]] = balances[_recipients[j]].add(_values[j]) - per-recipient balance mutation inside batchTransfer loop
